sanskrit_verse:
प्रदुष्टत्यक्तदारस्य क्लीबस्य क्षमकस्य च ।
स्वेच्छयोपेयुषो दारान् न दोषः साहसो भवेत् ॥
transliteration: praduṣṭatyaktadārasya klībasya kṣamakasya ca | svecchayopeyuṣo dārān na doṣaḥ sāhaso bhavet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When a woman abandoned by a corrupt spouse, or one who is impotent or excessively forgiving, consents independently to another's embrace, it does not constitute an offense of assault.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from conscious consent and integrity of relational capacity.
Causation arises from distortion in dharmic relational alignment, not mere physical act.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by clarity, autonomy, and absence of coercion.
Restoration logic prioritizes reintegration of relational harmony over punitive attribution.
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of free will within dharma-bound contexts.
executable_legal_axioms: IF (spouse_is_corrupt OR impotent OR excessively_forgiving) AND woman_consents_freely THEN action_is_not_assault.
IF relational_integrity_is_absent AND no_coercion_detected THEN act_does_not_invalidate_dharmic_order.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matrimonial disputes involving consensual acts post-abandonment or incapacity, the court must prioritize verification of autonomous consent and relational breakdown over statutory formality. The threshold for culpability lies in violation of conscious alignment, not societal norms.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that true causality stems from disruption of svadharma, not interpersonal movement of bodies. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that prior abandonment or incapacity dissolves prior relational binding. Thus, proportional responsibility rests solely on distortion of dharma-consciousness, never on natural response to imbalance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process between estranged spouses to restore relational clarity.
Verify integrity of consent through witness-independent consciousness assessment.
Realign individual capacities through dharmic counseling and svadharma reestablishment.
Integrate parties back into community dharma without stigma or punitive record.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores relational integrity through consciousness alignment. No punishment arises where dharma has already been disrupted. Reality itself adjudicates through svadharma. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
